reference.title: Markdown typical folder structure
reference.shortdesc: Tip : Organize Markdown content using a folder-per-topic model with a single _index.md file in

section.codeblock: Markdown Repository (ZIP) │ ├── _index.md (creates root DITA map hierarchy) │ ├── Alarms/ │ ├── _index.md (creates child topicref) │ ├── Alarm/ │ │ └── _index.md (creates child DITA topic) │ ├── Alarm_Management/ │ │ └── _index.md (creates child DITA topic) │ ├── Alarm_Notifier/ │ │ └── _index.md (creates child DITA topic) │ ├── Alarm_Types/ │ │ └── _index.md (creates child DITA topic) │ └── Terminology/ │ └── _index.md (creates child DITA topic) │ └── images/ ├── alarm-dashboard.png └── deployment-workflow.png

p.note: Organize Markdown content using a folder-per-topic model with a single _index.md file in each folder. This provides clear parent-child relationships and allows the converter to generate accurate DITA maps, topic hierarchies, and navigation structures.
